title: A closed immersion induces an isomorphism on residue fields
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $z\in Z$, and put $x=i(z)$. The homomorphism of residue fields $\kappa(x)\to\kappa(z)$ induced by $i$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Schemes, Definition Tag 01HK (definition-closed-immersion-locally-ringed-spaces: the map O_X -> i_*O_Z is surjective), together with the discussion before Lemma Tag 01J9 (lemma-characterize-points), which identifies residue fields as quotients of the local rings
